content: Yeyox te mõnãyxop yõg hãpxopmã'ax 'ãktux
Ha Paniye xop xix tik xop te hãmyũmmũg nũn, tu ta Yenoyanẽn tu' nũn, nũy Yeyox mũtik hãm'ãktux, tu' yĩkopit, hu:
—Teptu 'õg tik xexka xop te mõnãyxop yõg hãpxopmã'ax tat hok? 'Ap yãy yĩm pix'ah, nũy kũnãy tu tu' xit, tu kaxĩy mõnãyxop yõg hãpxopmã'ax tat 'ohnãg. Kaxĩy.
Ha: —Teptu 'ãxop te Topa yõg hãm'ãktux tu 'ãyĩpkox hok, pa mõnãyxop yõg hãm'ãktux tu 'ãyĩpkox pip?
Yã Topa te: “'Õg 'ãtak pu 'ãyĩpkox pi', xix 'ãtut pu'.” Kaxĩy. Tu xe: “Pũyã tu xok tik te' tak 'ãktux kummuk, xi' tut 'ãktux kummuk.” Kaxĩy.
Pa 'ãxop te tikmũ'ũn yũmmũgãhã', hu: “Tikmũ'ũn 'ũm yõg tayũmak pip, tu' tak 'ũm hã tu te hok, xi' tut hã tu te hok, nũy Topa pu' hõm, puxix hãpxopmã max,
'ĩhã' tak, pe' tut hã te 'ohnãg. Kaxĩy. Yã kaxĩy 'ãxop te Topa yõg hãm'ãktux putup nõg, nũy yãy yõg hãpxopmã'ax tat.
'Ãpa mũn max, pãyã 'ãkuxa mũn kummuk! Yã tik hittap 'Iyait te Topa pupi hãm'ãktux, tu 'ãxop 'ãktux, hu:

content.text: ‘Nũhũ tikmũ'ũn tek mũn 'ãktux max, pãyã' kuxa tek nĩm pax.
Tu yã hitop hã hãm'ãktux, nũy nũk-tetex 'ũgkeppah.
nũy yãy yõg hãm'ãktux 'ũyãnãn tu hãmyũmmũgã'.’ Kaxĩy. Tu ta tu' kux.” Kaxĩy.

content: Yeyox te' kuxa kummuk 'ãktux
Tu xe tikmũ'ũn xãnãhã', hu: —'Ũg 'ãpax, nũy hãmyũmmũg:
'Ũxit'ax te tikmũ'ũn kuxa kummugã 'ohnãg. 'Ãmhok. Pa yãy yĩy'ax te' kuxa kummugãhã'. Kaxĩy.
Ha tik xop te nũ mũtik hãpkumep, tu' nũn, tu' yĩkãgnãg hã' pip, tu: —Yãyã', 'ok xate hãmyũmmũg? Yã Paniye xop te 'õg hãm'ãktux putup nõg, tu' gãy. Kaxĩy.
Ha: —Yõgnũ 'Ãtak te pexkox tu' xip, tu mĩxux puknõg xohix mõy putup, nõm xok 'ohnãg tu'.
Pũyã' pi'! 'Õm te' pa hok xop putuk, tu' nõy mõgãp-tup, pãyã hãmpẽnã 'ohnãg, hãmyũmmũg 'ohnãg tu', hu' pẽnã hok nõy mõgã', puxi' pẽnã hok 2 te hãpkox kopa nã'. Kaxĩy.
Ha Pet te: —'Ãpu hãm'ãktux 'ũgmũ'a yũmmũgã'. Kaxĩy.
Ha: —'Ãxop te hãmyũmmũg 'ohnãg, tikmũ'ũn nõy putuk.
Hãpxop te' yĩkox hã mõ'nãhã', tu' tex ha' mõg, ha mõktu mõ'yõn, ha' kux,
pa' yĩy'ax te' kuxa kopa pip hãpxopmã'ax 'ãktux, tu' kummugãhã',
yã' kuxa kopa' pip hãpxopmã'ax te' nõy hã' xupxet, xi' nõy putex, xix hãpxopmã kummugãhã', yã hãmpe'paxex kummuk te' xupxetnãhã', xi' koitnãhã', xi' kupexyãhã'.
Hã kaxĩy 'ũkuxa kopa' pip hãpxopmã'ax te tikmũ'ũn kummugãhã', pa tu yĩm pix hok, nũy tu xit, yã hãpkummugã 'ohnãg. Tu ta tu' kux. Kaxĩy.
Tu yã 'ũn puknõg 'ãktux
Tu ta' mõg, tu kõmẽn Tinok ha' mõg, xix kõmẽn Xinõm ha' mõg,

ha hãpxexka Kãnã'ãg yõg 'ũn xip, tu ta' nũn tu nũktu Yeyox yĩka' xip, tu' yĩy ka'ok, tu: —Notot! Mõnãyxop Namix hã 'ãmõkputox xe'ẽgnãg, tuk kuxa ka'! Yãmĩy kummuk tek kutok hex kopa' xip, ha' xok putũmnãg. Kaxĩy.
Ha Yeyox yĩy 'ohnãg, yĩy tik xop te' yĩka' nũn, tu: —'Ãpu' xat, pu mõg. Yak mũk pe' nũn, tu' yĩy ka'ok! Kaxĩy.
Ha: —Topa te nũgkutnãhã 'Iyaet yõg tikmũ'ũn puxehnãg hah, nũy nõm tikmũ'ũn xaxok xop xax. Kaxĩy.
Ha 'ũn te' kopaxux hã' nãhã' Yeyox keppah, tu: —Notot, 'ãhã 'ãtehet! Kaxĩy.
Ha: —'A' max'ah 'ũk-tok yõg xit'ax xut, nũy kokex pu mõ'yõn. Kaxĩy.
Ha 'ũn te: —Hamũn. 'Ap koit'ah, pãyã pãmnãg te hãm tu' nãhã', 'ĩhã kakxop xit, puxix kokex mã'. Kaxĩy.
Ha: —Xok 'ũm, 'ãkuxa yũm ka'ok xexka 'ũgkopah. Pũyã Topa' mĩy xate nõm putup. Kaxĩy. Hãpxip 'ohnãg 'ĩhã kakxop hex hittup.
Yeyox te tikmũ'ũn punethok hittupmãhã'
Ha ta' mõg Yeyox, tu kõnãg xexka Ganinet ha' mõg, tu mõktu yĩktix tu mõ'kanĩn, tu' yũm,
ha tikmũ'ũn punethok te hãpkumep hok xop nũnnãhã', xi' pa hok xop, xi' yĩy hok xop, xi' pakut xop xohix nũnnãhã', tu Yeyox keppa nũ'xok, ha' xohix hittupmãhã'.

Ha tikmũ'ũn te' yẽy, 'ĩhã hãpkumep hok xop te hãpkumep, xi' pa hok xop te hãmpẽnãhã', xi' yĩy hok xop te hãm'ãktux, ha tikmũ'ũn te Topa pu hãm'ãktux, hu: —Topah, yã 'ãmax, 'ãmũn yã 'Iyaet yõg Topah, tu tikmũ'ũn hittupmãhã'. Kaxĩy.
Yeyox te yãy yõg tik xop xãnãhã', tu: —'Ãte tikmũ'ũn kuxa ka'. Yã' pip 'ãmnĩy tikoxyuk hã, 'ap hãpxop 'ũm pip'ah, puyĩ' mã'. 'Ãte' xat putup'ah, pu mõg, ka puãthaãt kopa' xakux, 'ũpu'uk tu'. Kaxĩy.
Ha: —Pi'yã' xip 'ũxit'ax xohix, puyĩy tikmũ'ũn xohix xĩnnã'? Yã kõmẽn tu hãptox tu' pip. Kaxĩy.
Ha: —'Õg pãm xohix te xĩy? Kaxĩy. Ha: —Pãm xohix te 7, xix mãhãm. Kaxĩy.
Ha Yeyox te tikmũ'ũn xat, pu hãm tu' mãhãm, ha' mãm,
ha pãm pop, xix mãhãm, tu Topa pu hãm'ãktux, hu: —Topah, yã 'ãmax. Xatek mũ'ã 'ũkxit'ax punethok hõm. Yã' puxi'. Kaxĩy. Tu pãm koxip xix mãhãm, tu tik xop pu' popmãhã', pu tu tikmũ'ũn xohix pu' nĩm.
Ha' xohix te' mãhã', tu' hi ka'ok. Yã' pip pãm punethok, yĩy tik xop te' xuk manax xohix te 7 kopah, ha nũ' tihi'.
Yã tik xop te' mãhã', 'ũxohix te 4.000, ha 'ũn te' mãhã kãmah, xix kakxop, 'ap nõm xop mõ'kupix'ah.
Ha Yeyox te tikmũ'ũn xat pu mõg, ha' mõg, ha Yeyox te mĩpkox hã mõ'nãhã', tu kõnãg yĩmũ' mõg, tu mõktu hãpxexka Mãganãg tu' xupep.
